name: Sakyou
source:
The director of the Tenshin Hospital, he's of the Violet status.
[url=/c74514]Kuroba[/url]'s mentor and former boss.
He will stop at nothing to achieve his goals, but medical care is always on his mind.

[spoiler]He is [url=/c87443]Shura[/url]'s blood-related brother, but he was adopted by the Violet family during his childhood because of his strong Violet traits.
